sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Interior Today LLC is a full-service exhibit stand contractor and custom exhibition booth company based in the USA with over 20 years of experience designing, fabricating, and installing trade show booths for clients across the United States and around the world.

Industry: Trade Show Booth Design and Construction · Size: not published · Products: Custom Exhibition Booths, Trade Show Booth Design, Booth Construction, Graphic Production Services, Installation and Dismantel Services, Audio Visual Services

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Interior Today LLC scores 11 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (11/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit, company size and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: ORAFOL Europe (11% similar on graphic, graphics, production, stands); Drytac (8% similar on graphic, graphics, floor, life); Mactac (7% similar on graphic, graphics, sign, construction). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
